title: Frozen v1.12 versus current native focused rigid benchmark

methodology.timing: raw elapsed samples and normalized milliseconds per operation; setup/preparation and post-timing exactness checks are excluded
methodology.exactness: body/dynamic/awake/max counters, transform/color revisions, all active matrix/color bits, replay hashes, and post-action evolution
methodology.acceptance: no win can be claimed unless candidate WASM is distinct, bridge provenance matches, timer-floor gates pass, and the 95% lower bound exceeds 1.03x

bodyEventApi.mapping: Set b3BodyDef.userData=(void*)(uintptr_t)(streamIndex+1), then decode event.userData back to streamIndex.
bodyEventApi.terminalPose: Always write events with fellAsleep=true; that event contains the final sleeping transform.
bodyEventApi.lifetime: The buffered event array is consumed before another step or body destruction; Box3D documents invalidation when bodies are destroyed.
bodyEventApi.hybridBoundary: Use moved-only events only immediately after a step and below a measured moveCount/dynamicCount crossover. Keep exported explicit b3w_sync_transforms on the full safe path because its most recent event array may be stale.
